post.title: Amazing family get together – Charris-ment
post.html: We stayed here this weekend as a large group of 21 for a family get together and all had a brilliant time. From point of booking, with our numerous questions before we arrived, Liz and Alastair replied promptly and did everything they could to ensure we had a great time. The best part for me was the games room with the large seating area upstairs which meant we could all be together on the evenings and the table tennis and pool table kept us all entertained. A beautiful place, lovely and quiet with gorgeous views and a lake nearby, but with pubs, shops etc within a short drive away. Would highly recommend and we will hopefully be back soon
